faq.q: o You Provide Wine Or Champagne?
faq.a: Can I Bring My Own? All of our cruises come with a complimentary bottle of sparkling cider, sparklng water, or plain flat water. We do offer the purchase of a bottle of wine (merlot or chardonnay) or champagne as an upgrade to the beverage provided. Guests must be over 21 to purchase this option. Because we offer wine and champagne as an amenity on the gondola, you will find our prices to be pleasantly competitive. Click here for current brands and prices.
